card.name: Baris
card.tagline: Balinese warrior dance depicting a young soldier's spirit
card.profile: Baris is a family of traditional Balinese war dances accompanied by gamelan, in which dancers depict the feelings of a young warrior prior to battle and glorify the warrior's commanding presence (Wikipedia). The name derives from 'bebarisan,' meaning line or file formation, referring to soldiers who served the ancient rajas of Bali. There is a non-ritual solo form (baris tunggal), often the first dance a budding dancer learns, and over thirty ritual group types named for the weapons carried (spear, shield, arrow, kris). The ritual Baris Upacara is a sacred wali dance used in temple ceremonies.
card.insight: Baris Upacara is one of the nine dances within the three Balinese genres inscribed by UNESCO in 2015, performed as an offering to welcome gods and ancestors (Jakarta Post).
